title: QuantClaim input v1
description: Domain claim payload assessed by the Quant adapter's validate_claim. claim_class is the gate declaration: the evidentiary tier the claim asserts (engineering correctness, data acceptance, out-of-sample empirical support, or real-market observation). The adapter maps claim_class plus evidence data_provenance to a maturity ceiling and never grants production_observed (ADR-0005 decisions 4/7).

study_id.description: Study this claim belongs to; binds the claim to the task/case scope of one study.

claim_class.description: Evidentiary tier asserted: engineering (code/run correctness), data_acceptance (dataset audit passed), oos_empirical (out-of-sample empirical result), real_market (paper-trading or production observation).

outcome.description: Outcome asserted by the source system. An asserted pass on oos_empirical or real_market does not by itself raise the evidence ceiling; provenance does.

limitations.description: Known limitations of the claim (survivorship, regime coverage, capacity). Required; explicit empty array only after consideration.

non_entailments.description: Statements this claim explicitly does not establish. Quantitative governance requires these (for example: a backtest result does not entail live-trading returns; a synthetic-data result does not entail real-data validity).
